papers.title: Stopping criteria for boosting automatic experimental design using real-time fMRI with Bayesian optimization
papers.abstract: Bayesian optimization has been proposed as a practical and efficient tool through which to tune parameters in many difficult settings. Recently, such techniques have been combined with real-time fMRI to propose a novel framework which turns on its head the conventional functional neuroimaging approach. This closed-loop method automatically designs the optimal experiment to evoke a desired target brain pattern. One of the challenges associated with extending such methods to real-time brain imaging is the need for adequate stopping criteria, an aspect of Bayesian optimization which has received limited attention. In light of high scanning costs and limited attentional capacities of subjects an accurate and reliable stopping criteria is essential. In order to address this issue we propose and empirically study the performance of two stopping criteria.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关于实时功能磁共振成像中的贝叶斯优化停止标准，与FEA代理建模或生物力学设计无任何关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper applies Bayesian optimization to fMRI experimental design, with no FEA, no surrogate modeling for mechanical simulations, no implant or biomechanics context, and no constraint handling or UQ relevant to structural design.

summary_zh.method: 提出两种基于贝叶斯优化的停止准则并实证比较
summary_zh.result: 所提准则能可靠地终止实验设计过程
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟和真实fMRI数据验证

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization for real-time fMRI design lacks adequate stopping criteria to minimize scanning costs and subject burden.
summary_en.method: Two stopping criteria are proposed and empirically evaluated within a Bayesian optimization framework for closed-loop neuroimaging.
summary_en.result: The proposed criteria provide reliable termination of the experimental design process with minimal performance loss.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using simulations and a real-time fMRI experiment.

papers.title: Transductive Log Opinion Pool of Gaussian Process Experts
papers.abstract: We introduce a framework for analyzing transductive combination of Gaussian process (GP) experts, where independently trained GP experts are combined in a way that depends on test point location, in order to scale GPs to big data. The framework provides some theoretical justification for the generalized product of GP experts (gPoE-GP) which was previously shown to work well in practice but lacks theoretical basis. Based on the proposed framework, an improvement over gPoE-GP is introduced and empirically validated.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文提出的高斯过程专家组合方法可用于构建大规模代理模型，可能迁移到生物力学有限元代理模型中。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address FEA sampling efficiency, constraints, or biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.result: 理论证明并结合实验验证了改进方法的预测性能提升
summary_zh.validation: 合成与真实回归数据集验证

summary_en.motivation: To scale Gaussian processes to large datasets via expert combination.
summary_en.method: A transductive combination framework for GP experts is introduced, with an improvement over gPoE-GP.
summary_en.result: Theoretical justification is provided and empirical validation shows improved predictive performance.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on synthetic and real regression datasets.
